title: Bitcoin ETF outflows show waning crypto appetite ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut
why_it_matters: ETF redemptions provide a measurable signal of changing institutional crypto exposure, but the timing alongside a high-profile AI listing does not establish that investors directly moved funds from Bitcoin into Anthropic shares.
caption:
RWA WIRE // CRYPTO MARKET

Bitcoin ETF outflows show waning crypto appetite ahead of Anthropic's Nasdaq debut

U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw nearly $2.9 billion in November withdrawals by November 19, as Anthropic's Nasdaq debut drew attention to competing demands for risk capital.
